main.description: Get the authenticated viewer's Atmosphere activity timeline. Groups contain visible activities from the returned page.

relatedActivity.description: Collection-specific activity references targeting this item's record. Article creations with related activity remain standalone; only the parent item's view is hydrated.

bskyPostRef.description: The Bluesky post associated with the rendered article or livestream, as declared by its author. The referenced post may not be available.

viewBskyPost.description: The hydrated Bluesky post associated with the rendered article or livestream, as declared by its author. Omitted when the post is unavailable to the viewer.

activityActorGroup.description: Activities by one actor in one collection, positioned at the newest group item. Only the newest item is hydrated. Article creations with related activity remain standalone.

uris.description: All visible group item URIs, including the hydrated item, in newest-first timeline order.

activitySubject.description: The shared target of grouped activities, not an activity itself.

bskyPostRef.description: The author's declared Bluesky post for the target. The post may be unavailable.

viewBskyPost.description: The hydrated Bluesky post declared by the target's author. Omitted when the post is unavailable to the viewer.

activityGroupItem.description: An unhydrated group item. Its actor DID is the authority of its record URI.

activityRelatedGroup.description: Visible activities in one collection targeting the parent item's record, without a time window. Contains references and profiles only, not a shared subject or hydrated action views. Buckets follow newest-first first appearance.

activities.description: Visible activity references in newest-first timeline order. Every activity has the bucket's collection.

actors.description: Unique actors in first-appearance order among the bucket's activities.

activitySubjectGroup.description: Activities in one collection sharing a target, by at least two distinct actors, positioned at the newest group item. Article recommendations and shares group separately across the returned page without a time window. Article creations are not subject-group items. Publication subscriptions and gallery favorites retain age-based grouping windows.

activities.description: Visible group items in newest-first timeline order. Every activity has the group's collection.

actors.description: Unique actors in first-appearance order among group items. At least two distinct actors are required.
